findings.description: Rize Up Bakery is opening a cafe in its SoMa production warehouse here, announced for Thursday 10 September 2026. The wholesale sourdough bakery supplies more than 70 accounts and ten farmers markets, and the story dates the cafe to a recovery from a burglary and a flood at the premises, each costing the business more than $100,000. The entry is dated to the article rather than to the announced opening, which had not happened when this was written. The founder is a private individual and is not recorded here.

extra.use: bakery cafe in an existing production warehouse
extra.stage: announced; not open at the time of the article

citation.label: The San Francisco Standard, “Rize Up, San Francisco’s first Black-owned sourdough bakery, is opening a cafe,” 27 August 2026

findings.description: Sergeant Ma, the sixth restaurant from Hi Neighbor Hospitality Group, is announced for the ground floor of the China Basin development here, opening 9 September 2026. The dining room overlooks Mission Creek across 3rd Street from Oracle Park and the menu runs to eighteen shared plates. The entry is dated to the article rather than to the announced opening, which had not happened when this was written. The restaurateurs are private individuals and are not recorded here.

extra.stage: announced; not open at the time of the article
